story: The stage was shortened by 40 kilometers after a loop was removed before the start. Eight riders formed the early breakaway, with only Benito and Soderqvist remaining on the final climb. After the jury cancelled the last local lap, the pair entered the final 2-kilometer with a one-minute lead. Soderqvist dropped Benito to win the stage and take the overall lead.
